Neumora Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: TOPL) today announced topline results from its pivotal Phase 3 KOASTAL-1 study evaluating navacaprant in adults with major depressive disorder.

In the study, navacaprant met its primary endpoint of change from baseline in the Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) total score at Week 6 versus placebo.

The Company plans to discuss these Phase 3 results with regulators and will present detailed data at a forthcoming medical conference.
